Booking with confidence

What to know
before booking.

A useful program page helps you decide before you pay. Here is what to look for, what stays private, and where to turn when you have a question.

Start with the provider

Provider applications are reviewed before approval. The public profile can show professional background, experience, education, certifications, skills, languages, and a portfolio. Look for the parts that relate to what you want to learn.

An approved application is a starting point for your research. Read the program itself and ask the provider about any requirement that affects your decision.

Use reviews for context

Seekers with completed enrollments can leave a rating and written review. Providers can reply publicly. Read what the reviewer actually says about the experience, and consider whether they were looking for the same thing you are.

A program without reviews may still have a detailed description and provider profile. Use those details and your own questions instead of treating missing feedback as a promise either way.

Check the booking you have selected

Read the delivery mode, level, selected date, full session schedule, and materials. When a program runs on several dates, your booking is for the selected run. That run may include more than one session. Review the schedule before continuing.

See the total before you pay

Checkout uses Stripe. The program price and service fee appear separately, along with the total. The receipt follows the same breakdown, and your payment history keeps the charge available to review. Card details stay with Stripe.

Access to program spaces

The video room, program files, announcements, and discussion are restricted to the provider and confirmed seekers. Direct messages are private conversations linked to a program. Use the appropriate space for the question you need to ask.

Read the current cancellation policy

You can request a cancellation within 24 hours of enrolling if the first session is still at least 24 hours away. The request is subject to platform approval. Check the current policy in the app before booking.

If the provider cancels the program, seekers receive a full refund to the original payment method. Refunds usually appear in 5 to 10 business days, and you are notified in the app and by email. Keep the program details and your receipt handy if you need support.

Need help with a booking? Email support@talent-share.com with the program name or public program ID and a description of the issue. Never send your card details.

Manage your account preferences

Your settings include notification preferences and account controls. Email, push, and marketing preferences are separate. You can also find account deactivation and deletion options in settings.
